test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about end standard?

options.text: It measures the distance between two parallel flat surfaces.
It is slower but more accurate.
It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines

solution:
The correct answer is __It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• End standard__ measures the distance between two parallel flat surfaces.
 
• It is slower but more accurate.
 
• Faces of end standards are subject to wear over time.
 
• It is not used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **End Standards:**

 
 
• End standards are widely used for precision measurements in industries.
 
• Examples include gauge blocks and slip gauges.
 
• They require careful handling to avoid wear or damage.
